title: 226 declared-tail refusals remain after T6, each on a tail carrying a name: 131 fprintf, 69 snprintf, 18 mk_print, 8 printf, in 132 functions
why: Card W44-LIBC-RESIDUALS added T6 (variadic_nested::is_literal_or_predefined_actual): a tail actual that is only literals and C11 6.4.2.2 predefined identifiers is data whatever the function's typed declarations or C02-P's closure say. It removed 974 of the 1,200 `arguments beyond the declared parameters of X` leaves at its base (967 literal-only tails, 6 literal actuals beside declared scalars, 1 whose statement spans lines) and moved no function. The 226 left (213 in 125 Unknown functions; 122 on librdkafka `RDUT:` macro lines, the user's own `fprintf(stderr, fmt, args)`) are, by the card's tail_residual.py, 223 on lines whose calls of X carry a named tail actual and 3 whose statement spans lines: a name is exactly what T1-T5 must decide, and they refuse it either because the function's declarations are unreadable or because the closure marks the name (a name passed to an uncontracted call is risky). Bound (census-tail-nested-after.json.gz): one non-Safe function has only tail refusals, monkey's `cb_debug_chunk_complete`, whose tail is `buf`, a tracked `mk_mem_alloc` allocation that is live at the call; admitting it needs a tail admission of a live tracked identity as a borrowed read. Discharge condition: that admission (a declared data tail read of a live identity, checked for liveness like a Borrowed actual) with matching audited Lean and its own attribution class; or a repair of the local declaration reader or of the closure's precision for the RD_UT bodies, re-measured; or acceptance as a measured leaf-only boundary. MK-PRINT-TAIL-ACTUALS' 18 remaining mk_print sites are among the 226.

title: 87 printf-family nested-call refusals remain: 58 whole-argument corpus-defined inner calls (rd_kafka_err2str 42), 28 inner calls inside a larger expression, 1 Cyrus SASL
why: Card W44-LIBC-RESIDUALS measured LIBC-PRINTF-NESTED-TAIL-CALLEES at its base: 89 `nested call Y inside a modeled call` leaves whose enclosing call is printf, fprintf, snprintf or sprintf, in 62 functions (11 fewer than W43-LIBC-PRINTF-FAMILY's 100: later wave-43 cards moved them). It declared the one libc inner callee a whole argument passes, `strerror` (libc/errno.qcore, resource_return_none()), which removed its 2 leaves. The 87 left (60 functions) split by the admission premise that refuses them: (a) 58 whole-argument calls of corpus-defined callees with no contract in force (premise N3): rd_kafka_err2str 42, rd_kafka_error_string 7, rd_kafka_msgq_len 3, rd_kafka_broker_name 2, rd_kafka_err2name, rd_kafka_event_name, rd_kafka_txn_state2str, rd_sockaddr2str 1 each; their lever is a validated W4 summary or a read declaration of the body (card W44-CORPUS-CALLEE-SUMMARIES' subject), after which N3/N6/N7 admit them unchanged if the result is `none` and every parameter borrowed; (b) 28 inner calls inside a larger expression (premise N4): `!(rd_kafka_msgq_len(..) == ..)` 9, rd_list_cnt 9, rd_buf_len 3, rd_kafka_msgq_size 2, `(double)(rd_clock() ..)` 2, `(long) getpid()` 2 (getpid agrees in 137 units but a declaration would decide nothing, so it is not declared), `path[strlen(path) - 1]` 1; (c) 1 `sasl_errstring`, outside libc. Bound: no function is blocked only by these refusals. Discharge condition: the corpus callees summarised or declared (each with its own reading and attribution), and a decision on N4 for a cast of or arithmetic on a `none` result; or acceptance as a measured boundary.

title: 127 `__builtin_va_start`/`__builtin_va_end` uncontracted-call leaves in 51 functions; `rd_kafka_set_thread_name` is now blocked by nothing else
why: Card W44-LIBC-RESIDUALS taught the declared-ABI reader `__builtin_va_list` and declared `vsnprintf` and `vprintf`, removing their 26 callee leaves (one leaf came back as a `resource call with a formal embedded in an unmodeled expression`). 24 of the 26 calling functions carry 50 `call to uncontracted function __builtin_va_start/__builtin_va_end` leaves, and across the corpus there are 127 in 51 functions (attribution/valist-callers.json). `rd_kafka_set_thread_name` (rdkafka.c) has exactly two leaves left, both of them. These are compiler builtins, not libc functions, so no declaration in quirin-provider-libc can state them (the placement rule and the ABI gate both need a C prototype). Discharge condition: a model of `va_start`/`va_end`/`va_copy` as custody-neutral operations on a local `va_list` object (they initialise and end the list; no tracked identity enters or leaves), with matching audited Lean and its own attribution class; or acceptance as a measured boundary.

title: The six glibc header-inline helpers are declared, not checked: a unit's own `__bswap_*`/`__uint*_identity` body is never compared with the declaration
why: Card W44-LIBC-RESIDUALS declared `__bswap_16/32/64` and `__uint16/32/64_identity` in libc/byteswap.qcore as the neutral element (scalar borrowed, resource_return_none()), stated as header-inline bodies. The definitions are spelled in glibc headers (bits/byteswap.h, bits/uintn-identity.h), outside the enumerated main-source denominator (E01-B2), so the analyser never projects them, and a name-keyed declaration replaces a body the unit carries with a trusted assumption. The declared-ABI gate compares the definition's signature (all six agree in all 174 defining units), not its body. Measured instead of gated: header_inline_census.py finds one (signature, body) pair per helper across all 174 units, each body integer arithmetic over its one scalar parameter. A host whose glibc differs is not detected by the analyser. Discharge condition: a per-unit body-agreement gate that withdraws a declaration where the unit's header body differs from the recorded one (with Lean parity), or a projection of header-inline bodies (an E01-B2 extension that keeps the main-source denominator) so W4 derives their summaries; or acceptance of the trusted assumption as the recorded decision it is.
